reviews.review_description: I tried twice to send you a picture of the process of sorting out who to use and my reasoning behind choosing Howrah Plumbing. I had 3 other quotes apart from you're 2. One was from interstate and was the cheapest but I felt had hidden costs and likely logistic problems. The other 4 local ( around Hobart) quotes I had quote on exactly the same system. Some tried changing things so quotes couldn't be compared , and one quote ( which I took as lack of experience ) mixed up 3 phase and 1 phase inverters.  2 of the people I dealt with kept passing my questions on to a 3rd party with some vital points being edited out in the process- hopeless!With Jonathan at Howrah Plumbing I had all my questions answered and he displayed a broad knowledge of various solar systems. All that I asked for I have received and  when supply became difficult ,I was upgraded at no extra cost.The trades people employed by Howrah Plumbing were very helpful and polite, enthusiastic, neat and tidy. I could not find fault and would highly recommend Howrah Plumbing.

Through word of mouth I was directed to Finn Peacock's website for solar quotes.  Within 24 hours I was contacted by 2 suppliers of solar systems in the Hobart area.  After speaking to Jonathan at Howrah Plumbing (and Electrical Services) I decided to go with his company.Jonathan's knowledge and experience of solar systems was excellent.  He was able to explain in terms that I could easily understand and he answered my many questions promptly.  He guided me to purchasing an excellent solar system that I am very happy with.  He didnâ€™t try to oversell a bigger system nor advise me to go with lesser grade panels as the other quote did.Chris and Junior, the installers from Howrah Plumbing arrived on time and installed everything with a minimum of fuss.  They obviously knew what they were doing.  They went through the instructions for the inverter that I needed to know patiently and knowledgeably.  After they finished installing the solar they then completed the other electrical work (extra power points, hardwired smoke alarm, new lights etc) that I had been putting off for a long time.I can thoroughly recommend Jonathan, Chris, Junior and Jarrah to do an excellent job from start to finish.
